instructions: SQL/migrations: preserve single-player RLS, immutable prompt_versions, soft-delete semantics. Content-blob migrations are TypeScript-side — do not invent raw SQL content rewrites unless intentional.

rules.rule: prompt_versions rows must remain immutable (no UPDATE of content). Runs reference versions permanently; never prune prompt_versions.
pages use deleted_at soft delete. Prefer soft-delete over hard DELETE unless explicitly migrating trash purge.
Every user-owned table must have RLS enabled with policies scoped to auth.uid() = user_id. Reject USING (true) write policies.
